name: subjective-chat
description: Dark desktop IRC client for the #subjective channel with inline DCC image transfers.

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/mobile-bridge.js
scripts.mobile:prepare: mkdir -p mobile-www/assets && cp mobile/index.html mobile-www/index.html && cp src/styles.css src/renderer.js src/mobile-bridge.js mobile-www/ && cp assets/* mobile-www/assets/
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=../.gradle ./gradlew assembleDebug
